package.description: Remote access VPN client for AT&T IP VPN services

en-US.description: Remote access VPN client for AT&T IP VPN services
en-US.longDescription: The AT&T Global Network Client for Windows allows your PC to easily access your AT&T IP VPN services to your company's corporate network as well as the Internet. It provides a simple, powerful interface that automatically detects and connects over cellular, WiFi, broadband and dial networks, and gives workers a consistent VPN access experience with highly secure remote access to keep communications and data private.
en-US.name: AT&T Global Network Client
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Update SQLite to version 3.53.2
- Update OPSWAT OESIS to version 4.3.6375
- Remove Wi-Fi database and the Wi-Fi update application from the client
- Address concerns, including all discovered by various scans
- Bug fix: Setting the profile from the command line
- Bug fix: Various minor bugs addressed

zh-CN.description: 用于 AT&T IP VPN 服务的远程访问 VPN 客户端
zh-CN.longDescription: 适用于 Windows 的 AT&T Global Network Client 让您的电脑可以轻松访问 AT&T IP VPN 服务，连接公司内部网络和互联网。它提供简洁而强大的界面，可自动检测并通过蜂窝、Wi-Fi、宽带和拨号网络进行连接，为员工提供一致的 VPN 访问体验和高度安全的远程访问，保障通信与数据的私密性。
